title: Women's Health and Fitness Day is a reminder to book a checkup
dek: National Women's Health and Fitness Day falls on September 30, a good nudge to put that overdue checkup on the calendar.
keywords: national womens health and fitness day
body: Three in the morning is when a lot of minds like to bring up everything that has been put off. For many people, that list includes a routine checkup that has not been scheduled in a while.

The timing fits, because September 30 is National Women's Health and Fitness Day, a day that promotes women's health at every age. I think it is a useful nudge for anyone, since so many of us take care of other people's appointments and let our own slide to the bottom of the list.

Many of us wait until something feels wrong before calling a doctor. It can help to think of a checkup as ordinary maintenance, the same way you would think about an oil change. It is often easier to book when you feel fine, and your doctor can tell you which checkups and screenings make sense for you.

The fitness side of the day does not have to be complicated either. A walk around the block after lunch, a few minutes of stretching before bed, or taking the stairs once or twice a day all add up over time. If you have health concerns, ask your doctor before starting something new.
Since you cannot call the office right now, write a note on your phone that says to book the appointment. Set a reminder for 9 a.m., and make the call before the day gets busy.
